body:
MAINLINE-005b check: p/2 agrees. Required core strength is the pinned pressure over two, 47730.41895695257 Pa, on P2, P2-A, P2-C, P2-K and P2-E. Thickness does not enter. Margins from the stated strengths match the card: 1.0475 shown as 1.05, 11.565 as 11.6, 22.418 as 22, 13.011 as 13, 23.046 as 23, and 2.137 as 2.1. 25 kPa fails and 70 kPa passes. Honeycomb and PMI from 20.8 kg/m3 up all clear by more than ten. Pins 12 of 12. The microlattice is PROJECTION and the header tags the rest QUESTIONABLE. 007 filed at 22:54:28, after this card at 22:37:56, so NFI-005B-007 matches the brief.

Mismatches. Row 1% strain, field 18-22 kg/m3. The only 1% point is 25 kPa at 14.4 kg/m3. Linear scaling reaches the requirement at 27.49 kg/m3. Density squared reaches it at 19.90. No exponent is stated. NFI-CHECK-005B-1PCT. Row Rohacell range, field RESULTS. The card lists 52-110 kg/m3 and 0.8-3.6 MPa, margin 17-75, with no RESULTS entry and no URL. Those strengths display as 17 and 75. NFI-CHECK-005B-RANGE. Row owner report, field ten times from 20 kg/m3 up. Pyrogel XTF at 200 kg/m3 has margin 2.137. The card's honeycomb-and-PMI sentence holds. This does not stop the card.
